# Emphasis delimiters

An underscore emphasis around _[a link](https://example.com)_ keeps its underscores.

An underscore emphasis around _`a code span`_ keeps its underscores.

An underscore emphasis around _<https://example.com>_ keeps its underscores.

An underscore strong around __![an image](image.png)__ keeps its underscores.

An underscore emphasis around _*an emphasis*_ stays two italics rather than one bold.

Asterisks stay asterisks: *[a link](https://example.com)* and *_text_* and **bold**.

Two in one paragraph: _[a](https://example.com)_ and _`b`_ and *[c](https://example.com)*.

- _[in a list item](https://example.com)_

> _[in a blockquote](https://example.com)_
